## Overview

This 2026-09-15 Alipay for Web page is an integration chooser. It links to Alipay **Web Drop-in** and **Web Components** child guides, then to the corresponding main Web integration guides. It contains no implementation procedure, SDK/API version gate, account or country/currency eligibility, payment request, return-status handling or successful-payment evidence. [[adyen]] [[adyen-online-payments]]

## Key takeaways

- The Drop-in link is described as an all-in-one UI solution for a website. The Components link is described as using **Redirect** to make Alipay payments on a website. That wording is a route description here; details of redirect action, return processing and outcome belong to the child guide.
- The page instructs readers to create their main integration before adding Alipay and links four main Web guides: Drop-in/Components each with Sessions/Advanced flow. Those links are navigation and do not by themselves prove that a specific Alipay method/version is enabled or supported for a merchant.
